tagline: This serverless compute release includes updates from Databricks Runtime 19.
what_it_does: This serverless compute release includes updates from Databricks Runtime 19. New features collect union aggregate function: The collect union aggregate function returns the distinct union of the elements in arrays within each group. Behavior changes HAVING is evaluated before window functions in queries with generators: For queries that include generators, such as explode, window functions are now evaluated after the HAVING filter.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
